issues.description: The Meal constructor parameter order differs between artifacts: the problem statement and solution expect Meal(String name, String[] ingredients), but the template declares Meal(String[] ingredients, String name). This mismatch will confuse students (and cause compilation or usage errors when following the provided Main examples and the UML), since example code and the specification use the other parameter order.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in the template Meal class to match the problem statement and solution: public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) and assign fields accordingly (this will align the template with the UML, the example usage in Main, and the solution).
